about: Mangalam Cement Limited, part of the B.K. Birla Group is a North and Central India-focused cement manufacturer selling under the Birla Uttam and Mangalam ProMaxX brands. It operates an integrated cement complex at Morak, Rajasthan, a grinding unit at Aligarh, Uttar Pradesh, and a small MDF-board division at Nabarangpur, Odisha.
